Name: AI Agent Monitor
Description: Live status of Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot sessions (working / needs you / idle), subscription usage, approve or deny permission requests from the deck, and one-press jump to the agent's window.
Author: Jos Bol

Actions.Name: Agent
Actions.Tooltip: Shows one running agent (attention first). Press to bring its window to the front.

Actions.Name: Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Subscription usage windows (5h / 7d) for Claude or Codex, the monthly budget for Copilot. Press to open the usage page.

Actions.Name: Overview
Actions.Tooltip: How many agents are working, waiting for you, or idle. Press to jump to the one that needs you.

Actions.Name: Attention → Monitor
Actions.Tooltip: For your main layout: lights up when an agent needs you; press to switch to the monitor profile. In 'back' mode it shows the overview and switches back.

Actions.Name: Selected agent
Actions.Tooltip: Details of the agent picked with the Select dial. Press to focus its window.

Actions.Name: Select dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate to pick an agent (shown on the Selected agent key); press to focus its window.

Actions.Name: Approve
Actions.Tooltip: Approves the permission request of the selected agent (or the most urgent one). Shows what it would approve.

Actions.Name: Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Denies the permission request of the selected agent (or the most urgent one).
